Coming soon

StayLock

Block distractions on a schedule. Pick the apps and sites that pull you away, set the hours you want to protect, and StayLock keeps them closed until the time is up.

The problem

Why it exists

Willpower runs out exactly when you need it. You pick up your phone to check one thing, and twenty minutes disappear into a feed.

Most blockers ask you to decide in the moment: turn it on, turn it off, snooze it one more time. That's the same decision you were already losing.

The approach

How it helps

StayLock moves the decision to when you're calm. Set a schedule once — work hours, study time, the hour before bed — and the block starts and ends on its own.

It's built the Focal Studio way: your schedules and block lists stay on your device, with no account to create and nothing in the app trying to keep you in it.

What’s coming

🗓️Scheduled blocksRecurring blocks for work, study or sleep that start and end on their own.
📵Apps and sitesChoose exactly which apps and websites each schedule keeps closed.
🔒Strict modeLock a block so it can't be switched off until it ends.
⏸️Short breaksTake a limited break when you genuinely need one, without cancelling the whole block.
📊Focus historySee how many hours you protected each week, kept on your device.
🔐Private by designNo account and no tracking. Your schedules and lists stay on your phone.

In the works

StayLock is coming soon.
